dashboard_components.title: Top Application Exceptions
dashboard_components.description: Most frequent exception classes per application.
dashboard_components.spl:
index=app_logs sourcetype=_json (Exception OR Traceback OR "stack trace")
| rex field=_raw "(?<exception>[A-Za-z_][\w.$]*(?:Exception|Error))\b"
| stats count AS occurrences latest(_time) AS last_seen BY application exception
| sort - occurrences
| head 10
| convert ctime(last_seen)
